graph.title: Graph
graph.lead: The code nodes of {{product}}: {{count}} with a page, each drawn from the graph the fill publishes.
graph.emptyShort: No code node has a page yet
graph.empty: The fill has published no node for {{product}} yet: pages appear here as its units publish.
graph.diagramsSlot: The diagrams of this node stand here once the graph holds one: no diagram of this node's kind is drawn from the graph yet.
graph.noFacts: The graph asserts nothing about this node yet.
graph.assumptionsNote: What an agent inferred, kept apart from the facts: an assumption is a reading to check, not a statement the graph asserts.
graph.noAssumptions: Nothing about this node is an assumption.
graph.noRelations: No edge of the graph names this node.
graph.noCoverageScopes: No scope of this node was read, so there is nothing to say about its coverage.
graph.noCoverage: The scopes {{scopes}} hold no coverage record: no stage said what it read of them.
graph.coverageReadCut: {{count}} more read entries are not shown.
graph.noQuestions: No question about this node is open.
graph.noDrafts: No unit holds a draft about this node.
graph.draftsNote: A draft is what a unit has written and not published: it is not a fact yet, and it leaves when the unit ends or publishes.
graph.noOrigin: The manifest declares no origin for {{repository}}, so this place is shown as text and links nothing.
graph.truncatedNote: This page is not the whole page:
graph.noPageSet: The server’s answer is no page set: the graph is shown nowhere until it answers one.
